scope: External recorded real sensors, no robot/hardware/LiDAR validation
window: First 60 seconds from earliest exact-paired camera timestamp, upper bound exclusive, maximum 1200 pairs
imu: Original measured SI rows; original clock; no future, synthetic or interpolated samples
calibration: Official camera and IMU calibration, cv2.stereoRectify, rectified T_imu_camera
metrics: transport plus image I/O wall latency
ATE: Only if verified body/camera reference and correct synchronized ground truth; otherwise unmeasured
latency_scope: Offline CPU replay, no realtime pacing claim; one-time rectification preprocessing reported separately
publication: Own compact derived metrics/calibration/hash receipts only; no dataset imagery/CSV
